t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are two major points. The first is that the gnomes always appear in the same pairing, although their position (L or R) will vary. The second is that each gnome will lead you to a bright forest with a red basket or a dark forest with a yellow basket. My goal is to work out which of the two forests currently has the most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: 1. The gnome pairings will always remain the same, but their position (left or right) will change.2. There are 2 forests that the gnomes can lead you to, a bright forest and a dark forest. You need to work out which of the forests (at that point in time) harvests the most mushrooms.3. The red, green, orange and blue gnomes will always lead you to the bright forest4. The brown, mauve, yellow and purple gnomes will always lead you to the dark forest
